experiment: Re-segment four frozen personal12 pose edits and evaluate actual saved pixels
source_arm: own JPEG from each participant's frozen mixed trial/Fisher run
gallery_rule: Lowest original row in each registered object for each person. Private contact sheets show original / source / neutral / prior / own / wrong; same choices irrespective of outcomes.
controls: neutral is a matched-codec unedited source; prior uses eight support images; wrong uses the previously fixed circular same predicted word and fold, preserving self for singletons. Compare own minus prior, own minus wrong and own minus neutral, plus prior minus neutral.
pose: Reopen each original and each generated JPEG. Apply pinned U2NetP using center crop, 320px LANCZOS, continuous saliency weights (pred-min)/(max-min). Positions use x right and y down in the unit square. Covariance trace sets log radius; anisotropy vector is [(Cxx-Cyy)/trace,2Cxy/trace].
primary: Mean squared Euclidean error of the actual two-component anisotropy vector versus the original, all 360. Query-specific evidence requires the object-bootstrap 95% upper bound below zero for own minus prior on all rows and own minus wrong within correct-word rows whose nonself donor shares the true object.
secondary: Mean Euclidean center error as fraction of image edge, absolute log-radius error. Doubled-angle axis error (0 to 90 degrees) only when original AND all four outputs have anisotropy length >=0.20; report denominator and target-only near-circular counts. Report threshold-free vector error on all. RGB32 RMSE and luminance Pearson. DINOv2-S/14 final unit CLS cosine: true original top1 of ten, all queries; the two-way independent decisions and joint assignment when both words correct, counting one pair once. Eight-support mean cosine per object under the current fold supplies an independent image-only 12-class probe (both viewed and predicted word hits). DINO source-to-edit cosine and class-decision retention test similarity to the actual unedited generated photo.
uncertainty: Paired 10000 draws of the global unique object identifiers, seed 260556, same multiplicity across people, all their photos and arms. Ratio-of-counts estimand; report n and contributing objects; no inference over people. Report individual and pooled cases. Strict pairs and independent-two comparisons condition on both mixed-model predictions being correct.
oracle: Old-panel true-target pose benchmark independently reported, with a distinct root; excluded from every personal12 count and interval.
clipping: Saliency moments represent visible foreground in the saved image; they do not establish human-annotated 3-D pose. Double-angle vector ignores head/tail reversals. Changes in endpoint estimates do not by themselves establish object preservation.
